t: Zendaya’s Daya by Zendaya Clothing Line Second Collection Interview | Vogue
s: May 3, 2017 - No matter the occasion, Zendaya makes the most of her fashion choices. At the Met Gala, she dazzled in larger-than-life Dolce & Gabbana couture, but the risk-taking multi-hyphenate brings that same sensibility to her casual moments, regularly turning the sidewalks into her personal runway. All of which lent itself, naturally, to a design career. Daya by Zendaya, which launched last year to robust popularity, is a sleek take on athleisure essentials at an attainable price for her youthful fan base.
